metrics.filter_note: Numstat sums non-merge commits once; merge commits count toward activity only. Exclude lockfile basenames package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, bun.lockb, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock; chore(sync): commits; and generated paths docs/generated/**, dist/**, build/**, coverage/**, *.generated.*. Test paths match *.test/spec.{js,ts,mjs,jsx,tsx,ps1} or tests/test directory entries; exclude dist/build/node_modules/fixtures/mocks/external-vaults. Ratio is test insertions / filtered net LOC, not coverage.
metrics.focus_area: Research-store retrieval, MCP scoping, TRM ingestion, and CI delivery validation

note: Evidence captured 2026-10-17 from frozen origin/main 1dfd20a44f32cb26f4b54384f27b11b69cd1f943; seven complete America/New_York days, [since, until), selected by committer timestamp. All activity clocks use fixed UTC-04:00 (no DST change in this window). Sessions and deep_sessions are unavailable: required integer fields use 0 as unmeasured sentinels, not observed absence. TODOS.md is absent from tracked main; backlog counters likewise use 0 as unavailable sentinels. No Claude session telemetry, private files, provider calls, or production state queried. Streaks are bounded to this window and end on its latest active date. Commit-type percentages use non-merge commits; 10 nonconventional subjects remain unclassified, so listed percentages need not sum to 100. Version range uses first and last release tags pointing at window commits in committer-time order. Prior baseline is a one-hour session, so raw productivity/LOC comparisons are not comparable; this record does not claim trend improvement or retrieval-quality acceptance. The audit schedule validates records but does not capture them: run the existing session-end check-retro-needed.ps1 and /retro process, validate, and force-add the ignored dated JSON during scoped delivery. This retro does not change freshness policy or add an automation.
